polarisDossierPackageFilesSelected.note: Most packages/polaris-dossier test files stay selected for a Trajectory change: they locate the repository or import a module that does, and the PR's governed documents make those readers. The bead's 'excludes the Polaris dossier tests' is met for the dossier browser tests only.

notes: [Observed] Integration stays near whole for a Trajectory change (97 of 107): almost every integration test locates and reads the real repository, and a Trajectory PR always carries governed documents.

[Observed] No Polaris dossier browser test is selected for PR #1007's diff; the flaky dossier hover case (syzygy-jetr) would not have run there. Most polaris-dossier package tests still are (see polarisDossierPackageFilesSelected).

[Inferred] A test that reads the repository through a root handed in by a module it does not import, a path assembled from parts naming no token, or a walk the WALKS pattern does not name, can be missed on a pull request. No unit test fails when a new test escapes the rule; the merge-group run is always whole, so such a miss fails in the queue, never on main.
